note: Template gold set. The real one is site-specific - it names this installation's own customers, suppliers and accounts - so it is not committed. Copy this to gold_set.json, replace the placeholder dates and codes with your own, then run with --rebaseline to pin the signatures. Thereafter every run compares against that baseline and reports logic drift separately from ordinary data movement.
